description: A list of headings that each show or hide a section of content, such as an FAQ, package details, or terms & conditions.

multiple.title: Several open & disabled
multiple.description: type="multiple" lets several sections be open together. An accordion can also sit in a card frame, and an item with disabled cannot be opened.

parts.root: Wrapper; controls which sections are open.
parts.item: One section (heading + content), separated by a line.
parts.trigger: Clickable heading, with an arrow on the right.

props.type: "single" = one section open; "multiple" = several at once.
props.collapsible: Only for type="single": the open section can be closed again.
props.defaultValue: Sections open at first. An array for type="multiple".
